## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is an entirely ineffective instructor who exhibits disgraceful control over his students. He is notably lenient in his teaching style.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)_

## Traits

- lenient  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)</sub>
- maintains disgraceful discipline  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- not effective whatsoever as an instructor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

During class, Mr. Pidgeon punished [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for smashing her slate over Hugh Carrow's head by making her stand at the front of the room and then sit beside Hugh. Later, on the last day of school, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) experienced an emotional farewell as Mr. Pidgeon departed from his role as teacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--pidgeon.md)

Mr. Pidgeon serves as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's school teacher. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) smashes a slate over Hugh Carrow's head for teasing her, Pidgeon punishes her by making her stand in front of the classroom and sit next to Hugh, which drives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to refuse to return to school. On his final day of teaching, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) feels emotional about his departure.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +6 more_

- Mentor of — school teacher and pupil  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pidgeon--sukey-pullen.md)

Mr. Pidgeon is romantically involved with [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md). He courts her and goes to visit her almost every night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_
